instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with an adjective or adverb.

atoms.b: Stellar University of Global Studies is situated in the ((vibrant)) city centre that has become a magnet for ambitious students worldwide.
Courses are structured ((systematically)), ensuring that theoretical knowledge is ((consistently)) linked to practical application.
For many international students, the campus atmosphere feels ((stimulating)), as it fosters both collaboration and independence.
Lectures are often delivered ((eloquently)) by professors who are regarded as pioneers in their fields.
Since the application process can be ((exceptionally)) demanding, candidates are expected to submit essays, recommendations, and sometimes attend interviews.
Nevertheless, the admissions team reviews each application ((fairly)), giving weight to personal achievements as well as academic records.
As a result, graduates leave the institution ((proficiently)) prepared to succeed in diverse industries around the globe.
Exchange programs are ((seamlessly)) embedded into the curriculum, making it possible for students to experience several countries during their studies.
